detail.longDescription: On a Mac? Check your live site for a .DS_Store file. Finder leaves them in folders and they list the names of the files inside, like backup.zip or old-admin.html, even if nothing links to them. curl -s https:// yourapp.com/.DS_Store | head -c 8 | xxd Bud1 in the output means it's public. Fix: add .DS_Store to .gitignore, git rm --cached, redeploy. https:// abbilabs.xyz/tips/ds-store-fil e-lists-your-files # infosec # webdev # macOS # AppSec # security # vibecoding # indiehackers # devtools
